video.title: Flagship Phone 16 Pro Review: Truth After 30 Days

comments.author: Sarah Connor
comments.original_text: The camera comparisons in this review are by far the cleanest on YouTube. Crisp audio too.
comments.suggested_reply: Thank you Sarah! Spent hours calibrating the lighting.

comments.author: Rohan Sharma
comments.original_text: Bhai camera quality zabardast hai, especially the low-light samples at 04:30!
comments.suggested_reply: Bahut shukriya Rohan! Night mode has improved drastically.

comments.author: Subhashis Roy
comments.original_text: Darun video da! Colour grading ebong sound design oshadharon.
comments.ai_summary: Praises video colour grading and sound design.
comments.suggested_reply: Onek dhonnobad Subhashis! Glad you enjoyed the grade.

comments.author: Elena Rostova
comments.original_text: Your pacing in this video is immaculate. No 5-minute sponsor intro, just straight to testing.
comments.ai_summary: Commends concise pacing without sponsor intro.
comments.suggested_reply: Keeping it focused is always our top priority Elena!

comments.author: Vikram Malhotra
comments.original_text: Ekdum honest review. Baki creators toh bas specs read karte hain.
comments.ai_summary: Praises honest review over specs reading.
comments.suggested_reply: Sach bolna hi humara aim hai Vikram bhai.

comments.author: David Chen
comments.original_text: Does the dedicated camera button get triggered accidentally in your pocket?
comments.ai_summary: Asks if camera button triggers in pocket.
comments.suggested_reply: Not once in 30 days David, the capacitive sensor requires intentional force.

comments.author: Priya Patel
comments.original_text: Battery life kaisa hai normal social media aur WhatsApp usage me?
comments.ai_summary: Inquires about battery life under typical daily usage.
comments.suggested_reply: Normal usage me easily 1.5 days nikal jata hai Priya!

comments.author: Liam O Connor
comments.original_text: Can you shoot 4K 120fps directly to an external SSD without frame drops?
comments.ai_summary: Asks about external SSD recording reliability at 4K 120fps.
comments.suggested_reply: Yes Liam, tested with a 1TB T7 shield and zero frames dropped.

comments.author: Ananya Das
comments.original_text: Ei phone-ta ki gaming er jonno bhalo hobe na overheating hobe?
comments.ai_summary: Questions gaming thermal performance and heating.
comments.suggested_reply: Heavy gaming-e ektu gorom hoy, tobe throttling kom hoyeche.

comments.author: Marcus Vance
comments.original_text: Will you do a long-term blind test against the Pixel 9 Pro camera?
comments.ai_summary: Requests blind comparison with Pixel 9 Pro.
comments.suggested_reply: Blind test video is in production right now Marcus!

comments.author: TechGeek99
comments.original_text: Please do a dedicated mic test comparing indoor reverb vs outdoor wind noise in part 2.
comments.suggested_reply: Great suggestion! Adding outdoor wind tests to the follow-up.

comments.author: Amit Verma
comments.original_text: Bhai battery drain test banao screen on 120Hz vs 60Hz.
comments.suggested_reply: Plan me hai Amit, next battery breakdown me include karenge.

comments.author: Jessica Wu
comments.original_text: You should include battery degradation graphs after 30 daily charging cycles.
comments.ai_summary: Suggests tracking battery health cycle metrics.
comments.suggested_reply: Solid idea Jessica, logging cycle stats for the 6-month check.

comments.author: Kalyan Banerjee
comments.original_text: Aagle video te speaker sound comparison dekhale khub shubidha hoy.
comments.ai_summary: Suggests speaker sound comparisons in upcoming videos.
comments.suggested_reply: Sure Kalyan, ager baar theke speaker decibel meter use korbo.

comments.author: Jordan Bell
comments.original_text: Consider making chapter markers clickable on the full timeline test.
comments.suggested_reply: Added chapter timestamps to description Jordan!

comments.author: Felix Mendoza
comments.original_text: The camera control slider freezes completely when switching between photo and 4K video.
comments.ai_summary: Reports camera control slider freeze when switching modes.
comments.suggested_reply: Can confirm this bug happened twice in my testing as well.

comments.author: Rahul Kapoor
comments.original_text: Overnight battery drain is terrible, losing 18% with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth turned off.
comments.ai_summary: Reports severe 18 percent overnight battery drain.
comments.suggested_reply: Check Background App Refresh Rahul, iOS 18 bug was causing indexing.

comments.author: Deepak Mehta
comments.original_text: Bluetooth audio disconnects randomly when connected to Sony XM5 headphones.
comments.ai_summary: Reports random Bluetooth disconnections with headphones.
comments.suggested_reply: Reported this to Apple engineering feedback Deepak.

comments.author: Tanmay Sen
comments.original_text: Display refresh rate 60Hz e atke jacche gaming apps theke berobar por.
comments.ai_summary: Reports refresh rate lock at 60Hz after closing games.
comments.suggested_reply: Temporary fix is locking and unlocking the screen Tanmay.

comments.author: Nigel Thorne
comments.original_text: You completely glossed over the price hike in Europe. It costs 150 euros more for zero base storage increase.
comments.ai_summary: Criticises omitting European price increase analysis.
comments.suggested_reply: Valid point Nigel, international pricing disparity should have been highlighted.

comments.author: Aakash Joshi
comments.original_text: Display brightness outdoor sunlight me thodi der baad dim ho jati hai, ye mention kyu nahi kiya?
comments.ai_summary: Criticises skipping thermal display dimming under sunlight.
comments.suggested_reply: Fair critique Aakash, thermal dimming happens after 8 minutes in direct sun.

comments.author: Chloe Martin
comments.original_text: Too much focus on cinematic mode. Most normal users just want to know if point and shoot works.
comments.ai_summary: Criticises overemphasis on cinematic mode vs casual use.
comments.suggested_reply: Noted Chloe, will rebalance towards auto-mode point and shoot.

summary: Viewers overwhelmingly appreciated the thorough camera comparisons, colour grading analysis, and concise pacing without lengthy sponsor interruptions. Several critics highlighted significant thermal display dimming under sunlight and international price increases. Audience members frequently inquired about real-world battery endurance and requested dedicated follow-up comparisons with the Pixel 9 Pro.
